definitions.aki: creatinine rise >= 0.3 mg/dL within 48 h above latest value in prior 48 h, or >= 1.5 x lowest value in prior 7 days within 7 days
definitions.hyperkalaemia: potassium >= 6.0 within 72 h; latest prior value (72 h) < 6.0 or none
definitions.hypoglycaemia: glucose < 54 mg/dL within 72 h; latest prior value (72 h) >= 54 or none
definitions.high_inr: INR > 4.0 within 7 days; latest prior value (7 days) <= 4.0 or none
definitions.high_tacrolimus: tacrolimus > 15 ng/mL within 7 days; latest prior value (7 days) <= 15 or none
definitions.time_reference: bundle decision timestamp; laboratory chart time

interpretation_boundaries: Markers reflect care actually received; they are not effects of any routing policy.
Markers are laboratory signals, not adjudicated adverse drug events.
Testing frequency differs between groups; compare event rates with measurement rates.
Bundles from the same patient are not independent.
